items.content_text: Greasemonkey has been a Firefox extension for well over a decade, with version 0.3.5 dating from 2005.  We've grown and changed a lot over that time.  With the upcoming Firefox 57 release , we need to change even more.  Mozilla is completely replacing the extension system in Firefox, to align with the budding Browser Extension standard, based on/shared with Google Chrome. items.content_text: As mentioned in the main post , Greasemonkey 4 is changing to be compatible with the Browser Extension API.  At its core, this set of APIs is completely asynchronous.  Greasemonkey's old " GM_ " APIs are typically synchronous.
